interactiveObjects.name: Ironbound Customs Strongbox
interactiveObjects.description: A riveted tax-box holding impounded passenger belongings and stamped transit writs.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: The strongbox clicks open, revealing confiscated coins and an unstamped harbor writ.

interactiveObjects.name: Seized Iron River-Gate
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: Salt-rusted iron bars have no lock cylinder; only raw strength can wrench the winch free.
interactiveObjects.description: A corroded floodgate sealing an old smuggling alcove beneath the piers.

transcript.speaker: Iron Winch
transcript.text: With a shriek of rusted chains, the floodgate lifts to reveal a dry smuggler's alcove!

interactiveObjects.name: Sealed Magistrate Ledger-Safe
interactiveObjects.description: A double-bolted iron safe containing confidential border casualty accounts.

transcript.speaker: Audit Archives
transcript.text: Inside lies the Black-Ink Expenditure Ledger proving the Furnace Guild stages border crises to harvest ash!

interactiveObjects.name: Main Retort Pressure Wheel
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: A heavy brass pressure wheel requires muscle, not lockpicks.
interactiveObjects.description: A scalding relief valve venting ash-pressure from the Lower Crucibles.

transcript.speaker: Foundry Works
transcript.text: Steam roars into the rafters as pressure drops, giving the quarry workers breathing room!

interactiveObjects.name: Pendulum Relay Vault
interactiveObjects.description: A clockwork compartment tucked behind the great escapement wheel.

transcript.speaker: Clockwork Belfry
transcript.text: Behind the relay gears you uncover a wax-sealed pact between High Auditor Crassus and Furnace Baron Vane!

interactiveObjects.name: Resonant Quenching Font
interactiveObjects.description: A shallow bronze basin humming softly whenever a soul bows in quiet remembrance.

interactiveObjects.name: Timber-Shored Ore Drift
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: Fallen chalk boulders block the drift; they must be heaved clear.
interactiveObjects.description: A collapsed chalk gallery hiding unrefined pale-iron and a forgotten miner's pack.

transcript.speaker: Ash-Quarry
transcript.text: You heave the chalk slab aside, exposing a seam of pale-iron and an old satchel.

interactiveObjects.name: Prism Memory Reliquary
interactiveObjects.description: A delicate brass-and-glass case storing rare bottled memories from the First Crossing.

interactiveObjects.name: Obsidian Toll-Coffer
interactiveObjects.description: A cold obsidian coffer bound in silver wire, humming with condensed soul-ash.

interactiveObjects.name: Chained Ring of the First Seal
interactiveObjects.description: The ancient silver ring that governed peaceful passage before the Chancery riveted its brass scales around it.
interactiveObjects.narrativeOpen: The Chancery iron collar lies split aside, exposing the humming silver arc of the First Seal.

interactiveObjects.name: Orla's Unstamped Supply Locker
interactiveObjects.description: An oil-smudged cedar chest beside the anvil, stocked with starter crafting billets for apprentice smiths.

transcript.speaker: Crucible Wharf
transcript.text: You gather a crisp shard of Tempered Kiln-Glass left out for forge trials.

interactiveObjects.name: Ancient Amber-Vein Pitch Cistern
interactiveObjects.description: A cracked stone basin catching slow, luminous drips of pure Cinder-Pitch Resin beneath the quarry galleries.

transcript.speaker: Catacomb Harvest
transcript.text: You draw a sealed copper cask of rich Deep-Slag Pitch and collect spare Cinder-Pitch Resin from the rim!

interactiveObjects.narrativeOpen: The cooled slag crust is pried back, exposing the glowing vein of Cinder-Pitch Resin.

interactiveObjects.name: Brass Star-Chart Cylinder
interactiveObjects.description: A weather-sealed brass scroll tube bolted beneath the shattered telescope dome.

transcript.speaker: Observatory Discovery
transcript.text: The corroded clasp gives way, revealing an intact Pre-Chancery Astral Star-Chart inked in silver!
